analysis.analysis: VIX has spiked 5% intraday to 33.6 while dealer gamma exposure has collapsed to -$524M, indicating dealers are short gamma and must sell into declines and buy into rallies, amplifying realized volatility in both directions. This combination of explosive vol regime and deeply negative GEX typically occurs during a sharp risk-off repricing event, likely triggered by a macro shock, earnings/credit scare, or forced deleveraging, with 5 new large flow trades suggesting institutional hedging or speculative positioning is accelerating the move. The CAG reading of BULL-DELUDED (1.09) suggests complacent positioning hasn't caught up to the vol spike, creating risk of a sharp unwind if sentiment capitulates. Negative gamma plus rising VIX is a classic precursor to gap moves and air-pocket price action in either direction.
analysis.regime_assessment: Explosive volatility regime with deeply negative dealer gamma (short-gamma environment) — high convexity risk, unstable price action, feedback-loop selling/buying likely amplified by dealer hedging flows.
analysis.model_trust: Low trust currently. LightGBM signals are trained predominantly on normal-to-moderate vol regimes and tend to underperform during gamma-driven dislocations; the conflicting signals across horizons (neutral 7d, bullish 14d, neutral 21d champion) reflect genuine model uncertainty rather than high-conviction edge. In negative GEX / explosive vol regimes, technical/ML signals should be heavily discounted in favor of volatility and flow-based risk management.
analysis.risk: Portfolio is exposed to amplified downside tail risk and whipsaw losses as dealers hedge short gamma positions, mechanically exacerbating selloffs; a BULL-DELUDED sentiment backdrop raises risk of a sharp sentiment-driven capitulation if VIX continues rising, with elevated slippage/liquidity risk on large directional moves.
analysis.action_detail: Increase tail-risk hedges (e.g., put spreads or VIX calls) and reduce net directional delta exposure; avoid adding new risk based on the bullish 14d ML signal given the explosive/negative-gamma regime; tighten stop-losses and reduce leverage until GEX normalizes and VIX stabilizes below ~28.
